name: ACMNet
summary: Northern Adelaide wireless/ADSL ISP (ACMNET PTY. LTD., ACN 113 645 257, founded 2005); litigation with Ai Tel (2007); founders later established NuSkope; wound down.

names.name: ACMNet
source: Earliest Wayback capture 14 Dec 2005 (self-describes as 'ACMNET - WISP now serving the northern areas of Adelaide'): https://web.archive.org/web/20051214020948id_/http://www.acmnet.com.au/

events.details: ACMnet Pty Ltd; wireless ISP (WISP) serving northern Adelaide (Salisbury/Brahma Lodge/Hillbank/Parafield). Earliest Wayback capture 14 Dec 2005 with 'now serving' launch language.

Wound down (founders later established NuSkope). Last live retail capture 29 Aug 2007; site then reduced to webmail/parked. (NuSkope founder link and 2007 Ai Tel litigation not independently verified via web archives.) Proposal's c. 2008 confirmed: last capture Jan 2008, founders operating NuSkope from 2007. retail pages live to 19 Jan 2008; founders at successor NuSkope from 2007.
source: Wayback CDX for acmnet.com.au (last retail capture 29 Aug 2007): http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=acmnet.com.au

refs.label: Site still live 19 Jan 2008; CDX probes confirm no later captures
